description: This file is a shell script initializing the system environment during early boot. It sets up essential virtual filesystems like proc, sysfs, devtmpfs, devpts, and tmpfs, creates necessary device nodes, and redirects shell input/output to console.

methods.name: do_mount_fs
methods.description: Mounts a filesystem of a specified type at a specified directory if the filesystem type exists.

methods.name: do_mknod
methods.description: Creates a device node if it does not already exist.
